result.answer: LinkedIn does not publicly list a customer support email or phone number accessible without logging in. However, they do provide an online contact form via their Help Center/Contact us page at: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/ask. You can also browse their Help Center at: https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin?lang=en for self-service support articles and community forums. Both the contact form and Help Center redirect to a login page, but the contact form URL is publicly known as LinkedIn's primary customer support channel.
result.blocker_detail: No blocking issues encountered. LinkedIn's customer support is only accessible through their online contact form (Send Feedback) at https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/ask and Help Center. No phone number or direct email address is publicly listed for general customer support.
